description: Search LiveDataLink's self-hosted official GovInfo Bill Status snapshot across bill number/title, all published titles, sponsor, policy area, legislative subjects, and committee names, with optional enacted and multi-version filters. Returns stable bill identifiers, sponsor/status facts, pagination, source XML hashes, and provenance. Use this for 'find 118th Congress bills about aviation safety', 'which border bills became law?', or 'bills assigned to the Finance Committee with multiple text versions'. Coverage is complete for HR and S in the 118th Congress only; resolutions and other Congresses are excluded. For Congress.gov's live/current API view, use the existing Congress tools instead.

bill_type.description: Hosted measure type: HR for a House bill or S for a Senate bill. Resolutions are outside this v1 snapshot.

enacted_only.description: When true, require at least one law citation in the captured Bill Status XML.

multiple_text_versions_only.description: When true, require at least two published GovInfo text-version links.

query.description: Bill number/title phrase, sponsor name, policy area, subject, or committee phrase.

response_format.description: Human-readable markdown or machine-readable JSON. Default markdown.

name: govinfo_legislation_search
